ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity cream pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (cream) central regions in both lobes, bounded by a continuous low-intensity (black) peripheral margin. Dense low-intensity dendritic mottling and linear streaks originate from the median notch and extend outward into the cream regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 58 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching 5-10 pixels in depth, particularly on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve from the notch, transitioning to a convex sweep at the outer lobes ending in tapered, slightly upward-curled tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right fluke tips; smaller, isolated white circular points visible near the median notch boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity (black) linear streaks visible; notably three parallel rake marks on the right lobe and several non-aligned diagonal streaks on the left lobe proximal to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization/scarring on both fluke tips; visible parallel rake marks on the right ventral lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Several faint, circular 'ring' or 'halo' scars (approximately 15-20 pixels in diameter) located on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.
